title: Offer farm debt mediation before enforcing a farm mortgage
what: Take enforcement action under a farm mortgage only while an exemption certificate is granted and in force for the farm debt.

sources.title: Farm Debt Mediation Act 2024 (Tas)
sources.quote: A Creditor must not take an enforcement action in respect of a farm mortgage unless an exemption certificate – (a) is granted to the Creditor; and (b) is in force in respect of the relevant farm debt

sources.title: Farm Debt Mediation Act 2024 (Tas)
sources.locator: s 5, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: Commissioner means the Farm Debt Mediation Commissioner appointed under section 11(1) ;

reach.condition: if it seeks to enforce a farm mortgage
